failures.fix: Update analyze_intent (or its schema) in sw-intent-analysis.sh to emit version, goal, and criteria fields matching the test's expected schema

failures.root_cause: sw-pipeline-test.sh: plan stage never writes .claude/pipeline-artifacts/plan.md, cascading to review/E2E/resume/cleanup failures, plus a jq parse error on a non-numeric complexity value in the RL/intelligence test

failures.fix: Verify sw-cost.sh reads loop.context_efficiency events from the correct events.jsonl path/timeframe used by the test fixture, and that seeded test entries fall within the 30-day window
